tour.audio.text: Enable confirmation sounds for saves, restores and rejected commands. Use the play buttons to listen to each success sound.
tour.audio.title: Hear the result
tour.background.text: Close the window to choose background mode or quit. Background keeps shortcuts active; reopen Sector from the tray or launcher. Quit stops the listener safely.
tour.background.title: Keep driving with Sector
tour.checkpoint.text: In LMU, press {save} to save your car's state, then {restore} to return to it. A new save replaces the previous checkpoint.
tour.checkpoint.title: Save a moment. Try it again.
tour.connection.text: Open offline Practice without EAC and enter driving. Sector connects automatically. Expand this bar to review status events, filter errors or export diagnostics.
tour.connection.title: Know when you’re connected
tour.launch.text: Use Open LMU without EAC, then choose Offline Practice and enter DRIVE. Sector checks for Easy Anti-Cheat: when detected, Save/Restore and their shortcuts are blocked. Close the game before reopening it here. For online racing, open LMU normally with EAC; overlays remain available.
tour.launch.title: Open LMU for Active Reset
tour.overlay.text: Choose widgets, toggle their parts and adjust size or opacity. Edit layout lets you drag and resize them on your display. Lock layout returns clicks to the game.
tour.overlay.title: Build your HUD
tour.settings.text: Open Edit → Settings to change app settings. Reduce motion minimizes interface animations. Preferences are saved automatically.
tour.settings.title: Set your preferences
tour.shortcuts.text: Click a shortcut, then press its new key. Choose unused game bindings. Return to LMU and release both keys before using them.
tour.shortcuts.title: Make the keys yours
